scope: Proposed assembly process with separate rotor and carrier preparation. Steps show before/after model states, not validated insertion trajectories. The rotor hub is real manufacturer geometry with a measured hub-to-sun pilot joint. The magnet carrier is an unreleased Primeform proposal that closes the 25.15 mm gap between the hub flange and the magnets; its retention on the hub is undefined. Later steps remain previewable despite unresolved earlier joints; they do not certify assembly completion.

surfaces: Housing front mounting face
Assembly fixture locating face

steps.check: Confirm datum, clamping distortion and access to both ends.

pathReview.reason: Fixture setup has no installation trajectory. Define housing datums and fixture access first.

Housing internal front seat, z = 8.75 mm

steps.check: Validate locating diameter, face flatness and assembly access.

pathReview.reason: The ring flange and its seat must pass the housing entry and internal shoulders after the 4.5 mm rearward realignment. No swept-volume check or insertion-side decision exists.

steps.check: Check thread engagement, bottoming, preload and tool clearance. Recheck screw tips if motor stack moves forward.

pathReview.reason: Each of the eight screws needs its own axis, head approach and driver access. Translating all screws from one global direction was incorrect.

steps.title: Seat prepared stator on housing shoulder, located by ring OD
steps.method: Adhesive / thermal bond; Coated sheet stacking + bonded bore; Formed insulation insertion; Wind / insert coils; Thermal attachment / lead connection; Impregnation / cure
surfaces: Stator bore 60 mm ↔ ring OD 59.96 mm (radial location, provisional bond gap)
Stator front steel face z 6.936 mm ↔ main housing annular shoulder (axial stop)
steps.process: Install the prepared 68-sheet stator over the compact ring OD until its steel end face seats against the housing shoulder at z 6.936 mm. Windings occupy z -7.8 to 7.8 mm. The stator, winding, ring flange and housing seat were all moved 4.5 mm rearward from the earlier Choice C position so the 13.872 mm stack overlaps the full magnet span (-7 to +7 mm). No long ring sleeve remains. Validate complete insertion access before animating motion.
steps.check: Choice C packaging only: 4 mm back iron, shortened radial winding region, 5.686 mm locating/bond overlap. The 9.436 mm axial misalignment is resolved in the layout, but flux, winding area, bond capacity, shoulder flatness and motor alignment remain unvalidated.

pathReview.reason: Full wound-stator insertion path and tolerance stack remain unvalidated. The stack is now axially aligned with the magnet span; electromagnetic and thermal performance are still unqualified.

steps.title: Rotor bench: hub and carrier, then bond magnets
surfaces: Magnet outer faces ↔ carrier web bore r 40.5 mm
Magnet axial end ↔ carrier retaining rim face, z 5.25 mm
Carrier web inner bore r 22.25 mm ↔ measured hub flange r 17.145 to 22.25 mm, z -1.75 to +0.25 mm
Magnet side faces ↔ pole-spacing fixture
steps.process: Assemble the rotor bench part of the subassembly: the measured hub (G03), the Primeform proposed magnet carrier (web plus retaining rim) and the magnet segments. The carrier web runs r 22.25 to 40.5 mm over z -5 to +5 mm and is anchored on the hub flange; the retaining rim closes the magnets at z 5.25 to 6.75 mm. Prepare surfaces, dispense a controlled bondline and place alternating poles with tooling, then cure. Adhesive and mechanical retention are unspecified. 42 pieces are assumed; OEM magnet segmentation is unconfirmed.
steps.check: The carrier is a Primeform proposal, not OEM geometry: it exists only because nothing in the source CAD joins the measured hub (flange outer r 22.25 mm) to the magnets. Measured clash 0 mm3 against the main housing and the hub, but 194.333 mm3 against the rear housing, whose inward wall is only r 29 mm over z -5.25 to -4.75 mm; shorten the web or resolve the rear envelope. The magnet radial band (r 40.5 to 42.5 mm) does not coincide with the arcuate slots in the source housings (r 41.766 to 43.236 mm), so the rotor radial placement is still unproven. Qualify bond thickness, temperature capability, cure and centrifugal retention, and verify polarity, spacing, concentricity and air gap.

pathReview.reason: Place magnets individually in the open carrier using polarity and spacing fixtures. Their placement directions and capture clearances have not been designed, and the carrier itself is an unreleased Primeform proposal.

steps.title: Rotor bench: hub joint - measured, but not released
steps.method: Measured interference/keyed pilot fit, O5.95 hub counterbore onto O6.0 sun journal
surfaces: Hub front counterbore O5.95 mm ↔ sun front journal O6.0 mm, contact z 3.75 to 5.25 mm, 0.324 mm3
Sun journal keyed/flat feature: 0.202 mm azimuthal radius spread across that band
Hub O12 front counterbore z 1.25 to 5.25 mm ↔ front 6701-ZZ outer race
Hub O6 rear bore z -8.75 to -6.75 mm ↔ rear 6701-ZZ and encoder target magnet
Hub flange r 17.145 to 22.25 mm at z -1.75 to +0.25 mm: nearest housing wall is r 47.4 mm, a 25.15 mm radial gap with no bridge anywhere in the source CAD
Hub flange r 17.145 to 22.25 mm at z -1.75 to +0.25 mm ↔ carrier web bore r 22.25 mm: proposed, not designed
steps.process: Fit the measured manufacturer hub (occurrence NAUO45, now exported as public/design/oem-rotor-hub.step and shown as assembly item G03) around the sun shaft. The hub is a body of revolution: six-spoke flange, O12 and O6 bearing bores, O4 middle bore and a O5.95 front counterbore. Its front counterbore pilots the sun's O6.0 journal over z 3.75 to 5.25 mm with a 0.324 mm3 interference and a keyed/flat feature on the sun. The hub is not attached to either housing by any modelled feature: its flange ends at r 22.25 mm and the nearest housing wall is at r 47.4 mm, a 25.15 mm radial gap with no bridge in the source CAD.
steps.check: Before release: (1) design and validate the hub-to-rotor-shell connection that closes the 25.15 mm radial gap, since the source CAD contains no such feature; (2) specify the fit class, retention, runout and balance for the O5.95/O6.0 keyed pilot joint and confirm its torque capacity against the 9:1 gearbox input; (3) confirm the sun drive feature from a physical sample, because a 0.202 mm azimuthal spread measured from CAD is not a released key or spline specification; (4) confirm the rotor radial placement, which the source housings do not confirm. (5) define how the carrier web is retained on the hub: no fit, key, screw or bond is specified between the hub flange and the carrier.

pathReview.reason: The hub-to-sun joint is now measured and real, but the hub-to-rotor-shell joint does not exist: the flange outer radius is 22.25 mm and the nearest housing wall is at 47.4 mm, so the hub is unsupported radially and cannot transmit rotor torque. No receiving surface, no retention and no insertion path can be reviewed until that connection is designed.

steps.title: Install rotor subassembly around stator
steps.method: Rotor subassembly / clearance review; Torque-transmitting joint unresolved
surfaces: Carrier web outer wall r 40.5 mm ↔ main housing bore (conical: r 44.050 at z -4.31 rising to r 47.500 at z 3.08)
Rotor outer swept envelope ↔ housing and boss clearance

Hub bearing bores ↔ 6701-ZZ bearings and encoder target magnet
steps.process: Inspect rotor subassembly outside the housing. No rotor installation route has been validated. Show the hub in its reference position. A press fit, key, spline or fasteners have not been established.
steps.check: Measured: the carrier web clears the main housing by 0 mm3 overlap because it stays inside r 40.5 mm, but it clashes with the rear housing by 194.333 mm3 and the hub has no defined retention to the carrier. The stator/magnet axial misalignment is resolved: stator, winding, ring and housing seat moved 4.5 mm rearward and the 13.872 mm stack now overlaps the full magnet span. A06 remains a measured failure because the hub-to-carrier joint is undefined, so the rotor subassembly is not buildable.

pathReview.reason: Build the rotor as a separate subassembly. The current yoke intersects housing bosses at the final position, so no valid installation path can end there. The hub-to-end-bell joint has no defined fastening or fit. Define the torque connection before deciding sequence, direction or required tools.

steps.process: Seat ownership is not established. The rear housing is shown as a receiving-part reference only, not as already installed. Decide which bearings fit to hub or housing first, and define the sun-to-hub torque connection before approving this operation.
steps.check: If an interference fit is chosen, apply force to the fitted race. Fits, preload, retention and seat geometry remain open. Resolve shaft/hub connection and retention. Tooth profile study does not validate the entire transmission.

pathReview.reason: The two bearings require individually identified seats, shoulders, fit and press-tool access. A shared axial translation cannot establish installation order. The sun shaft coupling and axial retention are undefined. Its enlarged gear and journal sections require a seat-by-seat insertion check.

pathReview.reason: Apply lubricant to accessible working surfaces at the appropriate assembly stage; it is not a rigid inserted disk. Select and model actual seals, grooves, shims and locking locations before defining their operations. A generic torus does not define assembly.
